Tracking the white cubes: the visible white cubes are the front-left-middle, the top-back-left, and the right-back-middle. The hidden cubes needed to complete the white piece form a column down the back-left edge and a row across the middle-back.

This gives the white piece: a straight bar of three cubes, with another bar of three crossing it at its middle cube, plus one extra cube sticking out perpendicular from that crossing cube — exactly the shape shown in diagram A (a three-bar with a perpendicular arm of two and a single cube at the center, matching under rotation without reflection).
